meta.title: perf: optimize event types listing page load time
meta.body_summary: Optimize event types listing page by adding lightweight repository methods and 30-second TTL caching for event types, workflows, and integrations, aiming to reduce data transfer and improve load time.

core_change_summary.description: Add lightweight repository methods in eventType.ts that fetch only essential user/host fields, introduce mapEventTypeLightweight to skip markdown rendering, and wrap three tRPC endpoints (getEventTypesFromGroup, getAllActiveWorkflows, apps.integrations) with a 30-second in-memory cache.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Secondary files add cache wrappers and lightweight method invocations in route handlers; most of the new code (214 lines) is in the repository module.
change_trajectory: Single commit: implements lightweight repository methods with caching for event types listing and related workflows/apps.
